The Python standard library in this binary
==========================================

The rustpython feature freezes the .py files of rustpython-pylib 0.6.0,
CPython's Lib directory, into the binary as bytecode. The library as a
whole is under the Python licence listed with that crate. These modules
carry notices of their own, reproduced here as their conditions ask.
Modules whose headers only name a contributor and say "Licensed to PSF
under a Contributor Agreement" are covered by the Python licence.
